adjudication.rationale: In `handleNewBooking.ts`, `evt.destinationCalendar` is set to `null` when neither `eventType.destinationCalendar` nor `organizerUser.destinationCalendar` exists (`destinationCalendar: ... : null,` around line ~1067). Immediately after, for collective team events the code does `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)` (around line ~1078). If `evt.destinationCalendar` is `null`, the optional chain prevents the push, so any collected `teamDestinationCalendars` are silently dropped. This is inconsistent with other call sites in the diff which use `[]` for the empty case and would allow pushing.
